result.paraphrase: Canvio Basics portable hard drive model HDTB320AK3CA offers an approximate 2TB capacity in black, with blazing-fast USB 3.0 transfer speeds and backward compatibility with USB 2.0. It includes an internal shock sensor plus ramp-loading technology to help protect your drive and data. Approximate dimensions are 78.75 x 119.4 x 16.5 mm (W x D x H), and the weight is about 178.6 g. Comes with a 3-year manufacturer warranty, a USB 3.0 cable that also works with USB 2.0, and a quick install guide. Product content: 1 x Toshiba 2TB Canvio 2.5 Inch USB 3.0 External Mobile HDD
